The one net-new finding below is a defense-in-depth test-coverage gap on the security-sensitive logout cache-purge allowlist.

evidence: AUTHED_QUERY_KEY_ROOTS (frontend/apps/ppt-web/src/lib/queryKeys.ts:354-392) is the security-sensitive allowlist AuthContext.logout iterates to removeQueries({queryKey:[root]}) so tenant/user-scoped TanStack Query cache never leaks into the next session on a shared workstation (AuthContext.tsx:614-637). Its own doc-comment records a history of misses: 'PR #2650 fix was incomplete - this [notification-triggers] root was missed' (queryKeys.ts:387-391) and issue #712.

The completeness guard queryKeys.test.ts auto-discovers roots from TWO sources only: the central `queryKeys` factory (Object.entries(queryKeys), test :102-114) and feature-local `*Keys` factories under features/** via import.meta.glob (:117-129). It asserts each discovered root is in the allowlist. It does NOT cover the two OTHER categories the allowlist is hand-maintained for: (a) ad-hoc inline query roots used directly in feature hooks that are NOT defined via a `*Keys` factory — confirmed present roots: developer, ocr, actionQueue, executionLogs, executionStats, financial, rentals (queryKeys.ts:372-380); and (b) external @ppt/api-client shared key-factory roots consumed by ppt-web — meters, reports (queryKeys.ts:369-371). Neither category is reachable by the test's discovery (import.meta.glob is scoped to features/**, and the api-client package is out of the app's glob root).

Current state is CORRECT — every live inline root (grep of `queryKey: ['...'` across non-test ppt-web src yields financial/rentals/actionQueue/person-months/ocr/executionStats/executionLogs, all present) and both external roots are in the allowlist, so there is no active leak today. The finding is a defense-in-depth REGRESSION-GUARD gap, not an active bug: a future tenant-scoped root added as an inline queryKey literal in a feature hook, or a new key-factory root added to @ppt/api-client and consumed by ppt-web, will pass CI yet silently survive logout and leak across sessions — exactly the class of miss that shipped notification-triggers (PR #2650) before it was caught by hand.

Fix (low-risk, test-only): extend queryKeys.test.ts with two assertions — (1) statically scan the ppt-web src tree for inline `queryKey: [<string-literal>, ...]` first-segment roots and assert each is in AUTHED_QUERY_KEY_ROOTS (or an explicit public/non-session opt-out set); (2) enumerate the @ppt/api-client key-factory roots ppt-web actually imports (meters, reports, messages, notification-triggers, ...) and assert each is covered. This closes the two discovery blind spots so no tenant-scoped root can be added without the allowlist failing CI. Confidence medium: the guard's coverage boundary is confirmed by static read of the test's discovery mechanism; that no live root is currently missing is confirmed by grep, but future-regression reachability is inferred, not runtime-confirmed.
